reasoning_input.question_text: Divide f(x) = 2x³ - 3x² + x - 5 by (x - 2) and state the remainder.

student_steps.content: Performing polynomial long division of 2x³ - 3x² + x - 5 by (x - 2)

steps.description: Set up polynomial long division correctly
First division step: obtain 2x² and subtract 2x²(x-2) correctly
Second step: obtain x (not wrong value) — correct subtraction gives -3x²+4x²=x²
Third step: correctly obtain 3 (constant term) from 3x-5 divided by x-2
State correct remainder using Remainder Theorem or long division: f(2)=2(8)-3(4)+2-5=16-12+2-5=1
Write the complete factored form correctly
